objective: Measure frozen task-codebook construction, compact codec latency, peak Python allocation, and session-start amortization for N in {8,16,32,64}.
claim_boundary: Latency is measured on the current Windows desktop CPU and Python runtime, not an embedded UAV processor.
Synthetic spectra are used only to exercise frozen algorithmic paths and do not support performance or generalization claims.
tracemalloc reports Python-managed allocation and is not total process RSS.
No closed development-test, reserve, or external Final signal data are loaded.
Session amortization includes the 64-bit activation and 24-bit ACK only; recurring traffic remains reported separately in prior full-protocol results.
